whyItMatters: springquery SQL assembles from parts (@Query("SELECT " + f)), so untrusted input rewrites the statement.
actions: Rewrite with :named parameters, binding every value.
Map dynamic identifiers through an allowlist.
Re-run the scan and confirm no assembled query remains on untrusted input.
